device.description: 16-bit single-channel voltage-output DAC with 2.5-V internal reference (enabled by default), 24-bit SPI-compatible write-only interface and power-down
device.note: dac8560.pdf (SLAS464C) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions (VDD 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-VDD), p.7 timing characteristics and Figure 1 serial write operation (SYNC falls with SCLK high, data on SCLK falling edges), p.21 enable/disable internal reference (26 SCLK cycles), p.24 power-down modes (Table 1), p.25 serial interface, input shift register, SYNC interrupt, power-on reset (all registers zero), p.26 register maps (Tables 2-5)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; p.25 power-on reset fills all registers with zeros (zero-scale output)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 (DB17/DB16) of the last valid data frame, Table 1 (00 normal, 01 1 kohm, 10 100 kohm, 11 Hi-Z)

registers.name: REF
registers.note: internal: OFF = internal reference disabled (Table 2; enabled by default); SEQ = enable sequence 1 of 2 (Table 3) received

commands.name: DISABLE INTERNAL REFERENCE
commands.note: Table 2 (p.26): 480401h followed by at least two more SCLK falling edges with SYNC low (26 clocks, p.21)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: Table 5: DB23-DB18 000000, DB17-DB16 PD1/PD0, DB15-DB0 data; executed on the 24th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts (SYNC interrupt, p.25)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.7 (timing, Figure 1), p.21 (reference enable/disable), p.24 (power-down Table 1), p.25 (serial interface, input shift register, SYNC interrupt, power-on reset), p.26 (Tables 2-5)
notModeled: analog output, output amplifier and the 2.5-V internal reference (REF.OFF stored only; VREF never driven)
power-down output loads (1 kohm / 100 kohm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 stored in CTRL.PD only
the reference words need 26 SCLK falling edges with SYNC low; modeled as 26-bit patterns (24-bit word + 2 don't-care bits). What a lone sequence-2 word does is not documented; the model ignores it
power-up time from power-down and output settling; SCLK limits t1-t10
variants: dac8560.pdf covers only the DAC8560 (A-D grades differ in accuracy, same interface). DAC8550/DAC8551 are the external-reference versions.
